o: If it hadn't been so cold, we would have stayed longer.
If I hadn't moved here, I wouldn't have met my husband.
They could have won the match if they had played better.
say: They could have won the match if they had played better.

p: Escucha y elige lo que oyes
o: If I hadn't moved here, I wouldn't have met my husband.
If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
She wouldn't have got lost if she had taken a map.

alt.p: ¿Cómo se dice «Si hubiera estudiado medicina, ahora sería médico.»?
o: You should have told me the truth from the beginning.

p: ¿Qué significa «Don't worry. This time we'll start early, and we'll study together. If you work hard, you will pass without any problem.»?
o: No te preocupes. Esta vez empezaremos pronto y estudiaremos juntos. Si trabajas duro, aprobarás sin ningún problema.
No seas tan duro contigo. Si yo hubiera estado allí, te habría ayudado. Y deberías haberme llamado desde el aeropuerto.
O could have. Si hubiera tenido más dinero, podría haber comprado la casa más grande. Significa que habría podido.
say: Don't worry. This time we'll start early, and we'll study together. If you work hard, you will pass without any problem.

p: ¿Qué significa «I would have called, but I didn't have your number.»?
o: No se habría perdido si hubiera llevado un mapa.
No debería haber dicho eso. Lo siento de verdad.
Habría llamado, pero no tenía tu número.
say: I would have called, but I didn't have your number.

p: Completa: The negative forms are easy. If I hadn't missed the bus, I wouldn't have been late. If they hadn't argued, they would still be _____.

p: ¿Qué significa «Another conversation, about a missed opportunity. Did you apply for the scholarship? No, I forgot about the deadline. If I had remembered, I would have applied.»?
o: Otra conversación, sobre una oportunidad perdida. ¿Solicitaste la beca? No, me olvidé del plazo. Si lo hubiera recordado, la habría solicitado.
¡Enhorabuena! Has terminado el segundo bloque del nivel B1. Este domingo tienes una prueba con todos los episodios de esta semana.

p: Completa: I shouldn't have _____ that. I'm really sorry.

say: I shouldn't have said that. I'm really sorry.

p: Escucha y elige lo que oyes
o: Don't be so hard on yourself. If I had been there, I would have helped you. And you should have called me from the airport.
You are right. I wish I had called you. I would have asked you to bring my other passport, and everything would have been fine.
Or could have. If I had had more money, I could have bought the bigger house. It means that I would have been able to.
